user_query: What margin and font size does the graduate school thesis-deposit guide require for the PDF?

retrieved_docs.text: Thesis deposit guide — Final PDF must use 1-inch margins and 12-point Times (or a close equivalent). Embed all fonts. The deposit window for May graduates closes 1 May at noon. Upload is through the ProQuest portal only.
